slug: 2025-03-12 Liberia says national ID system drives digital economy, facilitates service delivery

facts.fact: The National Identification Registry says an MoU with the Civil Service Agency (May 2024) allows national ID numbers to be used for payroll verification, helping identify ghost workers.
The National Identification Registry says an MoU with the Liberia Telecommunications Authority (October 2024) makes the national ID a requirement for SIM registration.
